summary: Iteration 47 - Backend testing complete for event recurrence, children import, family editing, staff-as-parents, access API connections, and guest access links. All 18 tests passed (100% success rate).
critical_code_review_comments: Circular import fix confirmed: access.py imports require_admin/require_staff from deps (not server)
Bimonthly recurrence correctly generates events every 2 months (Apr, Jun, Aug, Oct verified)
Quarterly recurrence correctly generates events every 3 months (Jan, Apr, Jul, Oct verified)
Custom dates recurrence works with explicit date array
Custom weekly (multi-day) recurrence works with days_of_week array
Children bulk import auto-creates families and parents with is_parent flag
Deduplication works: re-importing same child updates instead of duplicating
Family member editing endpoint (PUT /api/families/{id}/members) correctly links children and parents
Access API connections CRUD fully functional (create, list, update, delete)
Guest access links with token generation and public access request submission working
seed_data_creation: Test data created with TEST_ prefix for cleanup
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 47 verified all new features: (1) Event recurrence patterns bimonthly, quarterly, custom, custom_weekly all working correctly, (2) Children bulk import with auto-creation of families/parents and deduplication working, (3) Family member editing endpoint working, (4) Staff-as-parents included in portal/family response, (5) Access API connections CRUD working (MOCKED - stores config but doesn't call real door systems), (6) Guest access links with shareable tokens and public access request submission working. All tests pass.

event_recurrence_quarterly.details: POST /api/events/generate-recurring with pattern=quarterly generates events every 3 months (Jan, Apr, Jul, Oct)

event_recurrence_custom.details: POST /api/events/generate-recurring with pattern=custom and custom_dates array creates events on specified dates

event_recurrence_custom_weekly.details: POST /api/events/generate-recurring with pattern=custom_weekly and days_of_week array creates multi-day weekly events

children_bulk_import.details: POST /api/children/bulk-import auto-creates family and parent guest with is_parent=True

children_import_deduplication.details: Re-importing same child updates existing record instead of duplicating (imported=0, updated=1)

family_member_editing.details: PUT /api/families/{id}/members correctly links child_ids and parent_ids to family

staff_as_parents.details: GET /api/portal/family includes staff users with is_parent=True in parents list

access_api_connections_crud.details: CRUD operations for /api/access/api-connections all working (create, list, update, delete)

guest_access_links.details: POST /api/access/guest-links creates shareable token with expiry and max_uses

public_access_request.details: POST /api/public/access-request/{token} submits guest request via shared link

circular_import_fix.details: access.py imports require_admin/require_staff from deps (not server) - no circular import
